description: Rows from an IOOS tabledap dataset — station timeseries, glider profiles, water quality and asset inventories from a regional ocean observing association. AUTHORITATIVE for observed coastal conditions in US waters: this is the regional association's own quality-controlled archive. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for any "what did sensor X read" question.

constraints.description: ERDDAP constraint expressions, ANDed together. String values need their own double quotes: ["time>=2026-09-01", "station=\"edu_ucsd_cdip_201\""].

node.description: Which IOOS ERDDAP to ask. Each regional association holds different datasets and a dataset id from one will not resolve on another. "national" = IOOS-wide inventories, asset and metric datasets; "sensors" = the national in-situ sensor network — buoys, tide gauges, met stations; "gliders" = every US underwater glider deployment, temperature/salinity profiles; "pacioos" = Hawaii and the Pacific Islands — ROMS and WRF model grids, reef monitoring; "secoora" = the US Southeast — North Carolina through Florida and the eastern Gulf; "gcoos" = the Gulf of Mexico. Default "sensors", the national in-situ network.

variables.description: Columns to return, exactly as ioos_erddap_dataset_info spells them, e.g. ["time","sea_water_temperature","latitude","longitude"]. Omit for every column.

name: ioos_erddap_tabledap
title: Ioos Erddap Tabledap
